ability.effect: Each time this unit chants a prayer and the chanting roll is 12+, inflict 1 mortal damage on each enemy Priest and enemy Wizard on the battlefield.

ability.name: Resurrecting Touch
ability.declare: Pick a friendly Infantry Hero that has been destroyed to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
ability.effect: Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 3" of this unit.

ability.name: Grand Armageddon
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Shooting Phase
ability.declare: Pick each objective on the battlefield to be the targets.
ability.effect: Roll a D6 for each target. Inflict an amount of mortal damage on each unit contesting the target equal to the roll.

ability.name: Bound to Thyria
ability.effect: Heal (1) this unit.

ability.name: Forest Strider
ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had Fly.

ability.name: Skilled Healer
ability.declare: Pick either another visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit or a visible friendly faction terrain feature wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Heal (D3) the target.

ability.name: Deepwood Shadows
ability.effect: Friendly units are not visible to enemy units that are more than 12" from them while those friendly units are wholly within this unit's combat range.

ability.name: A Ghost in the Trees
ability.effect: If this unit is wholly within 3" of a terrain feature, remove it from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within friendly territory and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Shield of Thorns
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Nexus of Regeneration
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.declare: Pick each friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the targets.
ability.effect: Pick 1 of the following effects for each target: • Return 1 slain model to the target unit. • If the target is not a Monster. Heal (D6) the target. • If the target is a Monster, Heal (2D6) the target.

ability.name: Bound to the Cycle
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Movement Phase
ability.declare: This unit can only use this ability if it has been destroyed.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the current battle round number, set up a replacement unit wholly within 3" of a terrain feature and more than 9" from all enemy units.

ability.name: Seize New Offerings
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's attacks that target an enemy unit that has no other enemy units within its combat range.

ability.name: Willing Sacrifice
ability.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks while there are no other friendly units within its combat range.

ability.name: Prepare the Gift
ability.effect: Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of this unit's melee weapons used for attacks that target an enemy unit that is not damaged.

ability.name: The Wilderness Demands
ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, it can move 3". It can move into combat.

ability.name: An Offering in Kind
ability.effect: If an enemy unit was destroyed this turn by this unit's combat attacks, Heal (5) this unit. If that enemy unit was a Hero, Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points allocated to this unit.

ability.name: Marked for the Altar
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target. Then pick 1 of this unit's melee weapons to be the Sacrificial Weapon.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add the target's Control characteristic, to a maximum of 5, to the Attacks characteristic of the Sacrificial Weapon, but all of its combat attacks must target that enemy unit.

ability.name: Lord of Blood and Briar
ability.effect: While an enemy unit is in combat with this unit: • That enemy unit has a maximum control score of 1. • Subtract 1 from that enemy unit's power level, to a minimum of 0. • That enemy unit's attacks cannot score critical hits (treat them as regular hits instead).

ability.name: We All Must Make Sacrifices
ability.timing: Reaction: Your opponent declared a command for a unit within 6" of this unit.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll equals or exceeds the number of command points your opponent has, after the command has been resolved, inflict an amount of mortal damage equal to the roll on the unit using that command. This unit can use this ability more than once per phase but only once per command.

ability.name: Arboreal Concealment
ability.effect: Subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Defensive Thicket
ability.effect: If this unit did not charge this turn, roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, subtract 1 from wound rolls for combat attacks that target this unit.

ability.name: Bramblebarb Bushpods
ability.declare: If this unit did not charge this turn, pick an enemy unit in combat with it to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Fleet-footed Fighters
ability.effect: Roll a D3. If there are no enemy units within 9" of this unit, roll a dice instead. On a 2+, this unit can move a number of inches equal to the roll. It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but cannot end that move in combat.

ability.name: Hunter's Call
ability.effect: Each time this unit makes a pile-in move, it moves as if it had Fly and can move 6" instead of 3".

ability.name: Vital Souls
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.effect: If this unit is not in combat, return up to D3 slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to 12.

ability.name: Trap Mastery
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, subtract 1 from the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Rooted in the Undergrowth
ability.effect: Ignore all modifiers to save rolls for this unit (positive and negative).

ability.name: Bursting with Vigour
ability.effect: Add 2 to run rolls for this unit while it is not damaged.

ability.name: Sacrificial Frenzy
ability.effect: If no slain models have been returned to this unit this battle, add 1 to hit rolls for this unit's combat attacks while it is damaged or any models in this unit have been slain.

ability.name: Growing Wildness
ability.effect: Add the current battle round number to this unit's control score.

ability.name: Greenwoad Spirals
ability.effect: This unit has Ward (5+) against damage points inflicted by Spell abilities and abilities used by Manifestations.

ability.name: The Earth Rebels
ability.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Opponent declared a Charge ability for a unit within 12" of this unit
ability.effect: Roll a dice. You can replace 1 of the dice in that charge roll with your dice roll.

ability.name: Surge of Ghyran
ability.effect: If this unit is destroyed, before removing it from play, inflict D6 damage on each enemy unit in combat with it.

ability.name: Dandegryph Blowballs
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for a combat attack made by the target, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the Fight ability has been resolved.

ability.name: Watchers in the Green
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time your opponent declares a command for the target, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, unless your opponent spends 1 additional command point to use that command, the command has no effect, it still counts as having been used and the command points spent to use the command are still lost.

ability.name: Forager
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
ability.declare: Pick a terrain feature within 3" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: If the target is wholly within enemy territory, roll on the Exotic Ingredients table and add the corresponding ingredients to your roster. If the target is not wholly within enemy territory, roll on the Basic Ingredients table instead.

ability.name: Potion Pickpocket
ability.declare: Pick an enemy Hero that has a Ghyranite Concoction and is in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, the target no longer has that Ghyranite Concoction and give this unit that Ghyranite Concoction. If this unit already has a Ghyranite Concoction, it must immediately use one of those Ghyranite Concotions.

ability.name: Precious Ingredients
ability.effect: If this unit has a Ghyranite Concoction, this unit can immediately use the 'Retreat' ability as if it were your movement phase without any mortal damage being inflicted on it.

ability.name: Explosive Concoctions
ability.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Inflict D3 + 3 mortal damage on the target.

ability.name: Portable Brew Station
ability.effect: Pick a Ghyranite Concoction. If you have the ingredients listed in its recipe on your roster, you can immediately mix it. Remove those ingredients from your roster and give that Ghyranite Concoction to your unit.

ability.name: Impromptu Potions
ability.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
ability.effect: Roll a D3 and apply the corresponding effect: **1 *Potion of Instant Corrosion:* Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. 2 *Potion of Imprecision:* Subtract 1 from hit rolls for the target's attacks for the rest of the turn. 3 *Potion of Vulnerability:*** Ward rolls cannot be made for the target for the rest of the turn.

ability.name: Overcharged Elixirs
ability.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit's combat attacks while it has used a Ghyranite Concoction ability in the same turn.

ability.name: Waste Not, Want Not
ability.effect: Each time this unit uses a Ghyranite Concoction ability, roll a dice as a reaction. On a 5+, do not remove the Ghyranite Concoction from your roster as part of the effect of that ability.

ability.name: Morale Boost
ability.effect: Add 2 to the control scores of friendly units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

ability.name: Never a Stranger
ability.effect: Add 1 to save rolls for this unit while it is wholly within friendly territory.

ability.name: Knowledgable Guide
ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 friendly unit within this unit's combat range to be the targets.
ability.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 2" to each target's Move characteristic while they are wholly outside friendly territory.

ability.name: Expert of All Terrain
ability.effect: Ignore negative modifiers to: • Run rolls and charge rolls for this unit. • This unit's Move characteristic.

ability.name: Navigator Extraordinaire
ability.declare: Pick up to D3 friendly units to be the targets.
ability.effect: Each target can use the 'Normal Move' ability as if it were your movement phase.

ability.name: Traversal Gear
ability.effect: This unit can pass across terrain features as if it had Fly.

ability.name: Nature's Ally
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Hero Phase
ability.declare: Pick an objective or terrain feature within this unit's combat range to be the target.
ability.effect: For the rest of the battle, friendly units have Ward (5+) while they are wholly within 12" of the target.

ability.name: Master of Hidden Paths
ability.timing: Once Per Battle, Your Movement Phase
ability.declare: Pick this unit and up to 1 other visible friendly unit wholly within 6" of this unit to be the targets,
ability.effect: Remove the targets from the battlefield and set them up again with each model contesting the same objective or terrain feature and not in combat. The targets cannot use Charge abilities for the rest of the turn.
